message.content:
Oh, it varies a lot by customer. The parcel delivery guy probably has the biggest fleet—maybe a couple hundred drones, all the same model since they’re all about speed and reliability. The hospital logistics team is smaller, maybe fifty or so, but they’ve got some heavy-duty ones for carrying medical supplies.

The inspection company is all over the place—different sensors, different weights, so their fleet’s a mix of models. Some of those drones are built like tanks, others are lightweight scouts. I’d say between fifty and a hundred for them, but it changes depending on which projects they’re running.
